materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of highest education 5.Reference statement Reference statement signed by a referee living in China or abroad 6.Custody release form You can download a template or sample from here.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate or equivalent or above 2.Above 18 years old
